verdict.rationale: Retell's own Conductor can run simulation tests that play a scenario against an agent so changes can be checked without real phone calls. The dashboard Test button also starts a free web call that needs no phone number. AI QA, however, scores calls after they happen and sampled live traffic, so it is not a pre-deployment eval harness; simulation is documented only through one thin Conductor mention. Missing for 10: documented batch or regression test suites with pass/fail eval criteria, programmatic (API/SDK/CLI) simulation runs, details on scenario/persona configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the simulation feature.

support.subject: As a developer, I can test agents with simulated conversations or evals before putting them on real phone calls

citations.quote: Conductor can run simulation tests that play out a scenario against your agent and show how it responds. This lets you check changes without making real phone calls.
Click the "Test" button to start a web call with your agent... This step is free and doesn't need a phone number or payment method.
